leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Define a TypeScript interface to describe the shape of component input data
Apply the interface to a component class by implementing it in the component's properties
Initialize component state with data that conforms to the defined interface
Bind interface-typed properties to template elements using Angular's data binding syntax
Manipulate component methods to handle and transform data according to interface constraints
Render dynamic content in the template by accessing properties defined in the interface
Update component inputs with new data while maintaining type safety through the interface
